post.summary: Replace the contractor on a batch of contractor works assignments
post.description: All-or-nothing: the batch is validated up front and a single failed check rejects the whole request — `reassigned` comes back empty, `errors` carries the machine-readable reasons and nothing is written. Otherwise every assignment is applied in one transaction. Only the contractor changes — contract_id is left as it is. The contractor is replaced in contractor_works, work_cell_contractor and in the denormalized contractor_id of work_fact / work_limits / work_plan, plus labor_fact / lab_plan of the related labor assignment. Recalculation tasks and Kafka notifications are not triggered.

200.description: Either the whole batch was reassigned, or it was rejected with the reasons in `errors` and nothing was written

post.summary: Replace the contract on a batch of contractor works assignments
post.description: All-or-nothing: the batch is validated up front and a single failed check rejects the whole request — `updated` comes back empty, `errors` carries the machine-readable reasons and nothing is written. The target contract must belong to the contractor of every assignment in the batch. Otherwise the contract is replaced in contractor_works and in the matching work_cell_contractor rows in one transaction; the contractor itself never changes. After the commit the BDR recalculation is published to Kafka for the previous contracts and the target one.

200.description: Either the whole batch got the new contract, or it was rejected with the reasons in `errors` and nothing was written
